crossRefs.note: We have heard with our ears, God; our fathers have told us what work you did in their days, in the days of old.
My heart overflows with a noble theme. I recite my verses for the king. My tongue is like the pen of a skillful writer.
God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
Oh clap your hands, all you nations. Shout to God with the voice of triumph!
Great is Yahweh, and greatly to be praised, in the city of our God, in his holy mountain.
Hear this, all you peoples. Listen, all you inhabitants of the world,
How lovely are your dwellings, Yahweh of Armies!
Yahweh, you have been favorable to your land. You have restored the fortunes of Jacob.

So I have seen you in the sanctuary, watching your power and your glory.

I spread out my hands to you. My soul thirsts for you, like a parched land.

translations.web: As the deer pants for the water brooks, so my soul pants after you, God.
translations.bsb: As the deer pants for streams of water, so my soul longs after You, O God.
translations.kjv: As the hart panteth after the water brooks, so panteth my soul after thee, O God.
translations.asv: As the hart panteth after the water brooks, So panteth my soul after thee, O God.
